categories.name: Event data
categories.yields: What happened, hand-tagged: every pass, shot and tackle, with a timestamp.
categories.stops: Never how. No bodies, no joints — thousands of labels per match, each one a human judgment.
categories.cost_note: not in the HPX equipment plan

categories.name: GPS / GNSS vests
categories.yields: External load from a worn vest: distance, accelerations, PlayerLoad.
categories.stops: Your own squad only. Never the opponent, and never a match you did not kit.

categories.name: Optical game tracking
categories.yields: Spatio-temporal x, y for every player on the pitch, both teams.
categories.stops: Positions, not bodies. A multi-camera install, or a licensed feed.

categories.name: Markerless lab mocap
categories.yields: True 3D joint kinematics — the reference for a body in motion.
categories.stops: In a rig. Not from a broadcast, and never during a competitive match.
